note: Round 1541. Where every fact in src/data/basketballIntl.ts was read: two reads a fact, on two hosts that are not each other, none a wiki. Every page was opened by the round's builder on the day below through a fetch tool that answers with quoted sentences, so `words` is what that answer quoted, cut where a sentence was long; where a page lists a table rather than a sentence, `words` is the rows it printed. `who` names the publisher; fiba.basketball and about.fiba.basketball are one body and never count as two. Facts are keyed by edition id and fact name; scripts/simCareerIntl.mjs section 1 holds the join to the src rows. A fact with fewer than two reads carries `short` with the reason, and its edition is listed in BASKETBALL_INTL_PARTIAL.

fiba-minutes.says: A FIBA game, the Olympics and the World Cup included, is four quarters of 10 minutes, 40 minutes.

reads.words: Instead of the NBA's four 12-minute quarters, international games are split up into four 10-minute quarters. So a quick 40 minutes instead of 48 minutes.
Four 10-minute quarters will be played during Olympic play versus 12 minutes in the NBA.

nba-minutes.says: An NBA game is four quarters of 12 minutes, 48 minutes.

reads.words: All periods of regulation play in the NBA will be twelve minutes.
Instead of the NBA's four 12-minute quarters ... So a quick 40 minutes instead of 48 minutes.

notes.team-usa-mark: TEAM USA is a registered US mark of the US Olympic and Paralympic Committee: Justia's copy of the USPTO record 74522713 (registration 2455565, status 800 registered and renewed) and Docket Alarm's of 86505061 (registration 4773080). The USPTO's own search is a script page the fetch tool cannot read, so this is read off two mirrors of the register. The game never prints it: it says the USA or the US national team.
notes.wc-2027-host-place: Only one read says Qatar qualifies as host: Eurohoops, 13 May 2025, lists 'Asia (7 teams plus Qatar qualify)'. FIBA's own qualifier page (fiba.basketball, how to qualify for the World Cup) does not say it. One read is not a fact here, so a 2027 field the game draws does not force Qatar in.
notes.la28-host-place: Two reads say the USA has the host's place at LA 2028, both subject to a FIBA Central Board decision in 2027 (about.fiba.basketball Olympic men's page; the IOC qualification system carried by NOC*NSF, version of 12 May 2026). The game's own rule already puts the USA in every edition, so the host place changes nothing in the game.
notes.not-opened: olympics.com timed out on every request (as Round 660 found); eurobasket.com answered 403; usab.com was not found by search. None of them is cited.
